paragraphs: Edulog sells transportation software that school districts use to route buses, track vehicles, and account for the students who ride them. The company presents routing and planning as the base of the system, with add-on modules layered on top as a district needs them.

Alongside the software, an advisory group takes on the questions districts face away from the keyboard, such as reducing transportation costs. That group is staffed with former district transportation directors and data analysts. Its work covers bell-time optimization, district policy and contract analysis, demographics and redistricting, and operational assessments.

Edulog states that it created the first routing and planning software for school districts more than forty years ago. By its own account, its client districts run from as few as 57 students to as many as 1.8 million. It reports work with districts and transportation providers across 49 US states and four Canadian provinces.

quote.text: Edulog created the first routing and planning software for school districts over 40 years ago.
